release_notes: WHMCS v0.3.27: WhatsApp detects supported TelegramNotify media operations before photo/document upload, displays actionable gateway update and PHP size-limit errors and offers image retry. Existing app lock preferences and FCM registration are preserved. Live media preview/send requires the existing TelegramNotify addon upgraded to v3.4.5. Background push additionally needs an external Firebase service-account key and running TelegramNotify cron.
